title: Addition law for the specified common-stage Weil iterates
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D with characteristic p, a prime l different from p, an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l, and a finite-type k_0-scheme Y_0. Set Y=Y_0 ×_{k_0} k and g=g_Y. Use the actual common-stage pullbacks P_f and their compositor c(f,h) of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients, def-weil-local-frobenius-trace]. For any common-stage Weil complex K on Y and a,b≥0, write g^[r]=g^(r+1) and θ_r:P_(g^[r]) K→K for its prescribed positive Weil iterate. Then c(g^[a],g^[b])_K followed by P_(g^[a])(θ_b) and θ_a is θ_(a+b+1), after the equality g^[a] g^[b]=g^[a+b+1] of scheme maps. The formula uses the actual rational Weil maps, with no invariant integral lattice assumption.

source.place: Remark 6.8.15, p. 62; agent expansion of the constant-extension calculation in blueprint thm-zl-real-mixed-by-curves, proof paragraph 1, via lem-zl-classical-local-frobenius-iterate-comparison, proof step 8.

proof.text: Use the three-pullback equation of [lem-zl-large-composition-map-assoc]. Prove localPositivePower(g,a)≫localPositivePower(g,b)=localPositivePower(g,a+b+1) by induction on b and associativity of scheme composition. Induct on b in the Weil addition formula. The base case is the successor definition of weilIterate. In the successor case expand θ_(b+1), distribute the outer pullback over composition, and apply composition_map_assoc to f=g^[a], g=g^[b], h=g and t=K.str.hom. Postcompose by P_(g^[a])(θ_b)≫θ_a. Transport the induction hypothesis along the power equality in the dependent family f,t ↦ c(f,g)_K≫P_f(K.str.hom)≫t. Its right side is exactly the successor formula for θ_(a+b+2). All transports and morphism compositions are proved in Lean.

proof_origin: Q1: Lean induction on the second positive index, scheme-power addition and explicit dependent HEq transport; the independent three-pullback naturality/reassociation step is isolated as one smaller sourced obligation.

lean.statement:
theorem weilIterate_add (K : sfCommonStageWeilComplex D l hl Y₀ Ω) (a b : ℕ) :
    letI := sfWeilPrimeInvertible D l hl Y₀
    HEq
      ((composition l Ω
          (localPositivePower (D.geometricFrobenius Y₀).hom a)
          (localPositivePower (D.geometricFrobenius Y₀).hom b) K.carrier).hom ≫
        (@commonStageDerivedPullback l _ Ω _ _ _ _ _
          (localPositivePower (D.geometricFrobenius Y₀).hom a)
          (sfWeilPrimeInvertible D l hl Y₀) (sfWeilPrimeInvertible D l hl Y₀)).map
            (weilIterate D l hl Ω Y₀ K b).hom ≫
        (weilIterate D l hl Ω Y₀ K a).hom)
      (weilIterate D l hl Ω Y₀ K (a + b + 1)).hom
